summary: Answer strict bidirectional questions about explicit analyzed Email attachment imports from the existing workflow index.
decision_refs: The active objective requires adaptable file-grounded Email support alongside RFI and Submittal questions
The workflow index already preserves selected-attachment provenance after explicit import and analysis
A deterministic local answer avoids unnecessary evidence retrieval, model cost and mailbox access
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact Email or imported attachment file use the local shortcut.
Relationships exist only for attachments the reviewer explicitly selected, imported and analyzed.
Missing or duplicate target names, malformed relationships and more than eight results fail closed; repeated identical imports remain one relationship with a count.
The shortcut does not inspect a mailbox, prove that an Email had no other attachments or transfer workflow role, status, approval or authority.
